name: Levies
desc: Raised from the populace of the City and given the basic means of war. Traits:

name: Militia
desc: Rank and file, trained to hold and control. Traits: - -

name: Veterans
desc: Hardened by experience, keen and ready. Traits: - -

name: Shock Troops
desc: The tip of the spear. Traits: - - Sea Defense Outposts and Arks especially have the capacity of defense from nearby threats from the expanse of the Shard Sea. This is quantified in the same manner as…

name: Warden
desc: Leaders on the field of battle, a Warden can bolster any martial effort; concentrating leadership in a single person, of course, has its own risks.

name: Hospitaler
desc: A Priest of Bella, ill-suited to harm, but adept in healing.

name: Lumenary
desc: The servants of Lumen carry their command to war, the power command the might of the Heavens.

name: Friend of Death
desc: Scythe Bearers, wielding authority over lethality itself, able to inflict or ward against mortal perils.

name: Paladin
desc: The faithful, given might and strength to defend and repudiate.

name: War Mage
desc: The most lethal foe, one that can strike without exposing himself. Unfortunately for those that employ them, Mages are much more transient by nature than others.

name: Wreckers
desc: A detachment of highly trained Expeditioner-Soldiers.

name: Expedition Ordinaries
desc: Well equipped and ready, hardened by the Sea.

name: Town Guard
desc: Rank and file, trained to hold and control.

name: Binder
desc: Clever, volatile, able to meet almost any challenge with the right plans and Invokations.

name: Assassin
desc: Lethal, hiding behind the lines of a fight, an Assassin wages war orthogonal to the field of battle.

name: PC
desc: Your abilities as a Commander derive from your Disciplines and Skills, pick any three of those following which you qualify for (these can be changed at the start of any Battle.)
